narr: A moist easterly surface flow, combined with a disturbance aloft, resulted in scattered thunderstorms across the Billings Forecast Area. Some of these thunderstorms produced very heavy rain and large hail.
ev: A RV Park flooded with water running across nearby roads, drainages and culverts. Some culverts were damaged.
lsr: RV PARK FLOODED WITH WATER RUNNING ACROSS NEARBY ROADS DRAINAGES AND CULVERTS. SOME DAMAGES TO CULVERTS AS WELL.
